verdict.rationale: Zep's underlying temporal graph engine, Graphiti, is confirmed open-source on GitHub (zep-gh-1/2/3, zep-docs-15/43), and community praise reflects this (zep-comm-5). However, the core Zep product itself—the hosted Context Graph platform, zepctl CLI, and Memory MCP server—is presented as a commercial cloud/VPC deployment (zep-docs-17) with no evidence its source is published under an open license. missing for 10: confirmation that Zep's main product source (not just Graphiti) is open-licensed, and independent verification of that license's terms.
